name: RU58841
description: Non-steroidal antiandrogen that blocks the androgen receptor, first reported in 1994 for skin use

note.text: No published or registered trial in people with hair loss was found. The one human study measured drug levels after one dose.

bullets: **Blocks the androgen receptor** rather than lowering hormone levels
**In cells,** about as strong as hydroxyflutamide, a prostate cancer drug
**In scalp grafts on mice,** more follicles started a new hair cycle
**In people,** the mechanism is not established

practical.routes: On the scalp (single dose in 6 men)
practical.pharmacokinetics: Found in blood after one scalp dose; 5 metabolites in urine
practical.soldAs: Not approved anywhere; sold online as “research use only”
practical.monitored: Drug levels, urine steroid profile (one study)
practical.sport: Not named on the 2026 list; class S0 wording may cover it

regulatory.text: Not named; S0 may apply (no ruling)

references: Okutan et al., Biomed Chromatogr, RU58841 metabolism in 6 men, Oct 2026
De Brouwer et al., Br J Dermatol, human scalp grafts on mice, Nov 1997
